translations.web: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
translations.bsb: A king who judges the poor with fairness— his throne will be established forever.
translations.kjv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
translations.asv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.
